name: Skywrite
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 2, bard 2, druid/shaman 2, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 1 mile/level
Effect manipulated clouds
Duration 1 hour/level

You can manipulate or form clouds that can into words. You can create up to 1 word per caster level. You must be able to see the area in which you are forming the words and the words can be dispersed by a strong wind, ending the spell early. At the end of the spell’s duration the clouds disperse as if by a strong wind.
